title: Sandkit patches.json
description: Root shape of `patches.json`: a bare BundlePatch array (game format), or a BundlePatchesDocument object when the file includes `$schema`.

find.description: Exact source substring to locate in the bundle. Mutually exclusive with regex in typical patches.

code.description: Replacement or inserted source text. Official examples use `code`; some loaders also accept replace .

replace.description: Alias of code used by some patch loaders and workshop mods.

operation.description: How to apply the match. Defaults to replace-style behaviour when omitted in common workshop patches.

expectedMatches.description: How many times `find` / `regex` must match. Use a number (often `1`) so the load fails on miss or over-match. Some loaders accept `"any"`.

regex.description: Regex-based locator instead of a literal find string.

before.description: Text inserted before the match when operation is `"wrap"`.

after.description: Text inserted after the match when operation is `"wrap"`.

id.description: Optional stable id for logging and tooling.

atomicGroup.description: Group id shared by patches that must all succeed or all fail together. Use the same string on paired main (`js/bundle.js`) and worker (`js/simulation-worker.js`) patches.

occurrence.description: Which match to rewrite when `find` / `regex` hits more than once. `"all"` (default when omitted in the loader) or a 1-based index. Must not exceed expectedMatches when both are numbers.

description.description: Human-readable note for maintainers. Not required by the official schema.

BundlePatch.description:
One entry in `patches.json`.

The file is an array of these objects. Prefer `expectedMatches` so a missed or duplicated match fails loudly. When several patches must succeed together (for example main + worker), set the same atomicGroup on each.

PatchTargetFile.description:
Known compiled bundle paths the loader can patch.

| Value | Role | | --- | --- | | `js/bundle.js` | Main renderer | | `js/manager-worker.js` | Manager worker | | `js/simulation-worker.js` | Simulation workers | | `js/utility-worker.js` | Utility worker |

PatchOperation.description:
Supported patch operations.

| Value | Behaviour | | --- | --- | | `replace` | Replace the matched text with BundlePatch.code / BundlePatch.replace | | `remove` | Delete the matched text | | `insertBefore` | Insert BundlePatch.code before the match | | `insertAfter` | Insert BundlePatch.code after the match | | `wrap` | Surround the match with BundlePatch.before and BundlePatch.after |

pattern.description: JavaScript regex pattern source (without surrounding `/` delimiters). Capture groups may be referenced from BundlePatch.code as `$1`, `$2`, …

BundlePatchRegex.description: Regex finder when the target is not a plain BundlePatch.find string.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editors (for example VS Code). Not read by the game loader.

patches.description: Ordered patch list (same as the bare-array game format).

BundlePatchesDocument.description:
Editor-friendly `patches.json` wrapper with an optional `$schema` URL.

The game loader expects a bare BundlePatch array. Prefer that array in shipped mods. Use this object shape only when your editor needs inline `$schema`.
